Differentiate between Zero-shot, One-shot, and Few-shot prompting.

slides.title: The Foundation: Clarity, Context, Constraints
content: A weak prompt yields a weak answer.
A great prompt yields a great answer.
The best prompts utilize: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
narration: Poor prompts give unhelpful AI responses.
The best prompts utilize Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
These '3 Cs' are the foundation for quality AI interactions.
slides.image_prompt: An abstract graphic illustrating three pillars or segments, labeled 'Clarity', 'Context', and 'Constraints'. A path leads from a 'weak prompt' to a generic output, and another path from 'great prompt' through the 3 Cs to a high-quality output. Use a visual metaphor of building blocks.

slides.title: Clarity: Be Specific
content: The AI cannot read your mind.
Vague prompts produce generic, unhelpful responses.
Tell the AI exactly what you want it to do.
narration: The first essential element is Clarity.
The AI interprets your words literally.
Being specific avoids vague, unhelpful outputs.
slides.image_prompt: A person looking confused at a computer screen, with a thought bubble above their head showing a hazy, undefined shape. The AI on screen has a large question mark icon.

slides.title: Clarity: Vague Prompt Example
content: Prompt: "Write about electric cars."
What do you expect the AI to focus on?
narration: Consider this prompt: 'Write about electric cars.'
It seems simple, but it is quite vague.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: A user typing 'Write about electric cars.' into an AI chatbot interface. The chatbot's response area shows a generic, very broad, unformatted block of text about electric cars.

slides.title: Clarity: Why It's Vague
content: This prompt lacks specific instructions, topic, and purpose.
narration: The AI doesn't know what aspect to focus on.
It also doesn't know the intended audience or purpose.
This is like asking a chef to 'cook food' without details.
slides.image_prompt: An AI icon with a large question mark, surrounded by many possible topics related to electric cars (history, technology, environment, future). A thought bubble shows a confused expression. A chef's hat is visible in the corner for the analogy.

slides.title: Clarity: Improved Prompt Example
content: Prompt: "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
This prompt clearly defines the format, length, topic, and audience.
narration: Let's refine our prompt for better results.
This improved version specifies a short blog post.
It targets city dwellers and top three electric car benefits.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison. Left: Previous vague output (generic text about electric cars). Right: New output from the clear prompt, showing a structured, short blog post highlighting 3 specific benefits for city living. Highlight the difference in output quality.

slides.title: Context: Give Background
content: Context informs the AI 'why' you are asking and 'who' the audience is.
It helps the AI adopt the correct perspective and tone.
Like providing background story to a character.
narration: The second essential element is Context.
Context provides the AI with background information.
This helps the AI understand purpose and audience.
slides.image_prompt: Visuals of audience types: a student with books, a business professional in a suit, a lifestyle blogger with a camera and notebook. Each figure is connected to an abstract AI brain icon with a thought bubble showing 'understanding context'.

slides.title: Context: Adding Background
content: Previous Clear Prompt: "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
Better Prompt (with Context): "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
narration: Building on our prompt, we now add more context.
We specify it's for a 'sustainable lifestyle blog'.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison. Left: Previous output (generic benefits). Right: New output showing a blog post tailored with sustainability themes and lifestyle language. Emphasize the shift in tone and content.

slides.title: Context: Tailoring the Output
narration: This directs the AI to use appropriate language and themes.
It ensures the content suits that specific niche.
The AI now understands the 'why' behind your request.
slides.image_prompt: Visuals of a blog post adapting its style. A blog post on the left looking generic, transitioning to a blog post on the right with icons and text clearly showing 'sustainable living' themes and a lifestyle tone. Use a visual representation of tailoring.

slides.title: Constraints: Setting Boundaries
content: Constraints are boundaries that shape the AI's output.
Define desired length, format, style, or specific inclusions/exclusions.
narration: The third essential element is Constraints.
These are specific rules you set for the AI's response.
They act as boundaries, shaping the AI's output.
slides.image_prompt: Icons representing various constraints: a clock for time/length, a word count icon, a document icon with bullet points for format. A fence or boundary visually represents the 'rules'.

slides.title: Constraints: Guiding the AI
narration: Constraints guide the AI on how to structure its output.
You can specify length, format, or tone.
Think of it as giving a chef a recipe to follow.
slides.image_prompt: A chef holding a recipe book with ingredients and steps, juxtaposed with an AI robot processing instructions. The recipe represents the constraints. Focus on the analogy.

slides.title: Constraints: Applying the Rules
content: Previous Better Prompt: "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."

Excellent Prompt (with Constraints): "Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments."
narration: Let's apply constraints to our prompt.
We specify length, tone, and a concluding question.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison. Left: Previous prompt. Right: New prompt, highlighting the added constraints like 'under 400 words', 'friendly and enthusiastic tone', and 'end with a question'.

slides.title: Constraints: Tailored Output
narration: This ensures a perfectly tailored, engaging, and compact piece.
The AI now delivers content precisely as requested.
slides.image_prompt: A blog post that is exactly under 400 words, has a friendly, enthusiastic tone, and concludes with a question for readers. Highlight these specific changes. A clock icon for length, a smiling face for tone, and a question mark icon for the ending.

slides.title: The Power of the 3 Cs: Comparison
content: Vague Prompt: "Write about electric cars."

Clear + Context + Constraints Prompt: "Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments."
narration: Observe the remarkable transformation of our output.
From a vague request to a perfectly tailored blog post.
The 3 Cs dramatically elevate your AI interactions.
slides.image_prompt: A visual comparison showing three distinct outputs side-by-side or in a progression: 1) Vague output (long, unformatted text). 2) Clear + Context output (more focused, slightly better tone). 3) Excellent output (short, formatted, engaging, with a question). Use arrows to show improvement.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: Tell the AI who to 'be' or 'act as'.
This guides the AI's perspective, knowledge base, and tone.
It's like assigning a specific role to an actor.
narration: Here's a powerful bonus tip: provide a persona.
Tell the AI to 'act as' a specific role or expert.
This defines its knowledge, tone, and focus for better results.
slides.image_prompt: A friendly AI robot figure on screen, with various 'hats' floating around it or placed on its head (e.g., chef's hat, doctor's stethoscope, writer's glasses, travel agent's airplane pin). This visualizes the AI adopting different roles.

slides.title: Persona Example: Expert Travel Agent
content: Prompt: "Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food."
The AI now provides tailored advice from a specific viewpoint.
narration: Ask the AI to 'Act as an expert travel agent'.
Request an itinerary, specializing in budget travel.
The AI's response will instantly reflect this specialized knowledge and tone.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: A user typing the persona-based prompt into an AI chat interface. The AI's response is a well-structured 5-day Rome itinerary, clearly written from the perspective of a budget travel expert, with specific historical sites and food recommendations.

slides.title: Giving Examples: Shot Prompting
narration: Sometimes, the AI needs to follow a specific format.
This is where 'Shot Prompting' becomes highly useful.
It involves giving the AI examples to learn from.
slides.image_prompt: A simple graphic showing three sections: 'Zero-Shot' with no example, 'One-Shot' with one example (input -> output), and 'Few-Shot' with multiple examples (input -> output, input -> output). Use a clear visual distinction for each.

slides.title: Understanding Zero-Shot Prompting
content: Zero-Shot: No examples provided (most common).
narration: Zero-shot prompting is the most common approach.
Here, you provide no specific examples to the AI.
It relies purely on the AI's existing knowledge.
slides.image_prompt: An AI robot thinking, with no input examples shown. A large '0' symbol represents zero examples. Focus on the AI's internal knowledge base.

slides.title: One-Shot Prompting for Format
content: Purpose: Teach AI a specific output format.

Example: "Summarize text into key points like this: Text: 'The sun is a star, and it's the center of our solar system.' Output: 'Primary celestial body: Sun'\nNow, use this format for the following text: [insert long article here]"
The AI mimics the provided example's structure.
narration: One-shot prompting enforces a specific output format.
You provide just one example pair of input and desired output.
The AI then applies this pattern to new information.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: A user typing the One-Shot prompt. The example 'Text: Output:' is clearly visible, followed by the instruction to apply it to a new, longer text. The AI's response shows the summarized text in the exact key-point format of the example.

slides.title: Few-Shot Prompting for Complexity
content: Purpose: Teach AI complex patterns, tone, or style with multiple examples.
narration: For complex patterns, few-shot prompting is ideal.
It involves providing several input and output examples.
This method helps the AI grasp nuanced relationships.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: A user typing a Few-Shot prompt for sentiment analysis. Show 2-3 pairs of 'Review: [text]' and 'Sentiment: [positive/negative/neutral]' examples. The examples are highlighted.

slides.title: Few-Shot: Deepening AI Understanding
content: More examples help the AI grasp nuanced relationships.
narration: This technique works well for classifying sentiment.
It is also useful for writing with a specific style.
It is truly about showing the AI, not just telling it.
slides.image_prompt: An AI robot's brain icon showing increasing complexity or deeper connections being formed with multiple data points/examples flowing into it. A magnifying glass over 'nuanced relationships'.

slides.title: Summary
content: The 3 Cs (Clarity, Context, Constraints) are essential for effective prompting.
Clarity ensures specific, focused output.
Context helps the AI understand purpose and audience.
Constraints define output format, length, and style.
Providing a persona guides the AI's perspective and expertise.
Shot prompting (Zero, One, Few) uses examples to teach patterns.
narration: To summarize, master the 3 Cs: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
These ensure your AI prompts are specific, purposeful, and rule-bound.
Also, remember personas and shot prompting for advanced control.
slides.image_prompt: A visually appealing summary slide with key takeaways from the tutorial. Use small icons for each point (e.g., magnifying glass for Clarity, target audience for Context, rulebook for Constraints, mask for Persona, example box for Shot Prompting).

slides.title: Assignment: Practice the 3 Cs
content: Task: Create a social media post for a new local coffee shop.
1. Write a vague prompt and observe the AI's response.
2. Add Clarity to your prompt and note the improvements.
3. Incorporate Context (e.g., 'for a student audience on Instagram, promoting a quiet study space').
4. Introduce Constraints (e.g., 'under 100 words, include 2 hashtags, use an inviting tone').
5. Compare the four AI outputs and identify the impact of each C.
narration: For your assignment, create a social media post.
You will progressively add Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
This hands-on practice solidifies your understanding of the 3 Cs.
slides.image_prompt: A split screen showing a 'before' side with a generic coffee cup and a vague social media post, and an 'after' side with a vibrant, targeted social media post graphic and a 'check mark' for successful prompting. Include icons representing the 3 Cs.
